title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — BadgerCare Plus Screening Before Approval
content:
On Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tiers where BadgerCare Plus screening is required, an applicant must complete a BadgerCare Plus eligibility screening before approval: a Medicaid screening referral notice is sent, and the BadgerCare Plus determination notice must be provided within the screening deadline days of the referral.

- If BadgerCare Plus is granted with coverage of the dates of service, the encounters are rebilled to Medicaid instead of receiving charity care, and only the balance Medicaid leaves to the patient is considered under the award.
- If BadgerCare Plus is denied, the denial notice satisfies the requirement.
- If no determination notice is provided by the deadline, the application is denied for the reason "Medicaid screening not completed".
- Tiers where screening is not required are approved without a screening.

### Outcomes

| BadgerCare Plus determination notice by the deadline | Outcome |
|---|---|
| granted, covering the dates of service | encounters rebilled to Medicaid; only the balance Medicaid leaves to the patient is considered under the award |
| denied | requirement satisfied |
| none provided | application denied, Medicaid screening not completed |
